prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a hit while turning left. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1079; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while turning left. The reported mechanism is consistent with the injury diagnosed, which is a concussion with post-traumatic headache and intermittent dizziness. Over the course of sixteen visits, care consisted of graded symptom management, vestibular and oculomotor exercises, cervical physical therapy, and periodic neurologic reassessment. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms improved and the patient was gradually discharged from active therapy. Examination findings include reduced tolerance to visual tracking and mild balance deficits on tandem testing, which support the clinical diagnosis. Other components of the neurologic examination, including cranial nerve function, strength, sensation, and coordination, were within normal limits. No prior injury to the cervical spine or head is documented in the available history. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated billing observed. Current status is improving, and the patient is expected to reach maximum medical improvement with continued home exercise and symptom monitoring.
